mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST shows sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with low growth
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS falls > 100,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) over three months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the combination signals an accommodative monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2% and UNRATE < 4%.
